description: This file defines the Local class for file transfer operations within Drupal, specifically handling file copying, directory creation/removal, and permission changes, with deprecation notices indicating it is outdated in newer Drupal versions.

classes.name: Local
classes.description: A class for handling local file transfer operations, including copying files, creating/removing directories, and changing permissions, with deprecation warnings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Local object with jail path and file system service.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: A no-operation method for establishing a connection.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the Local class with jail and settings.

methods.name: copyFileJailed
methods.description: Copies a file from source to destination, throws exception on failure.

methods.name: createDirectoryJailed
methods.description: Creates a directory, throws exception if creation fails.

methods.name: removeDirectoryJailed
methods.description: Removes a directory and its contents recursively, throws exception on failure.

methods.name: removeFileJailed
methods.description: Removes a file, throws exception on failure.

methods.name: isDirectory
methods.description: Checks if a path is a directory.

methods.name: isFile
methods.description: Checks if a path is a file.

methods.name: chmodJailed
methods.description: Changes permissions of files/directories recursively if specified.
